description:
The Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Pension Scheme is a significant initiative launched by the Government of Haryana.

This scheme was officially launched on January 1, 2019.

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial security to construction workers in their old age.

The scheme aims to ensure that registered construction workers receive a monthly pension of ₹3,000.

This pension amount is intended to support workers who have contributed to the construction sector for a minimum of five years.

The scheme targets construction workers aged 60 years and above.

To be eligible for the pension, workers must be registered with the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3 lakh.

Workers must also have contributed to the welfare fund for a minimum of five years to qualify for the pension.

The application process for the Pension Scheme involves several specific steps.

First, the applicant must fill out the application form available on the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board's official website.

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, age, and registration number.

Applicants must also provide proof of age, which can be a birth certificate or an Aadhaar card.

Additionally, proof of income must be submitted to confirm that it does not exceed the threshold of ₹3 lakh per annum.

Once the application form is completed, it must be submitted to the local office of the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The local office will process the application and verify the submitted documents.

Upon successful verification, the applicant will be enrolled in the scheme.

The pension amount of ₹3,000 will be disbursed monthly.

Disbursements are made directly to the bank account of the registered worker.

The frequency of pension disbursement is monthly.

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

This board operates under the Department of Labor and Employment, Haryana.

The contact details for the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board are available on their official website.

As of October 2023, the board has registered over 1.5 million construction workers.

The total corpus of the welfare fund has exceeded ₹1,000 crores.

The scheme also includes provisions for other welfare measures such as health insurance and educational assistance for the children of construction workers.

Workers can also avail of financial assistance for the purchase of tools and equipment.

The Pension Scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the living standards of construction workers in Haryana.

The government has set a target to increase the number of registered workers under this scheme by 20% annually.

The scheme was introduced in response to the growing need for social security among construction workers.

Construction workers are often engaged in informal employment and lack access to traditional pension schemes.

The Haryana government recognized the vulnerability of these workers and aimed to provide them with a safety net.

The Pension Scheme is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all eligible construction workers.

The scheme has been well-received, with many workers expressing gratitude for the financial support.

The Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board conducts regular outreach programs to educate workers about the scheme.

These outreach programs are held in various districts across Haryana.

Workers are encouraged to register and apply for the pension scheme during these programs.

The government has also partnered with local NGOs to facilitate the registration process.

As of 2023, the scheme has successfully disbursed pensions to over 100,000 beneficiaries.

The Haryana government has allocated ₹200 crores for the pension scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the welfare of construction workers.

The board also conducts periodic reviews of the scheme to assess its impact and effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further.

The Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is committed to transparency in its operations.

All financial transactions related to the pension scheme are monitored and audited regularly.

The scheme has also been recognized as a model for other states to emulate.

The government encourages other states to adopt similar pension schemes for construction workers.

The Pension Scheme is a testament to the Haryana government's efforts to provide social security to marginalized workers.

The scheme not only addresses the financial needs of elderly construction workers but also promotes their dignity.

The Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board continues to expand its services to include more welfare measures.

The board aims to create a comprehensive support system for construction workers and their families.

In conclusion, the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Pension Scheme is a crucial initiative that provides financial security to construction workers.

With a monthly pension of ₹3,000 and a focus on inclusivity, the scheme aims to uplift the lives of workers who have contributed to the state's development.

The scheme's implementation by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board ensures that workers receive the support they need in their old age.

The government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of construction workers through this and other initiatives.
